title: Alternating Turns
paragraphs: “Ah, yes. It’s been quite a struggle.”
“Bufufufu, I have heard the news. It seems Melromarc suffered great damage as well.”
“Yes, I never expected the Three Hero Church to go on such a rampage. If it weren’t for the heroes, I don’t know if we could have handled it.”
“Bufufufu, indeed. The Three Hero Church has now been recognized as a heretical cult on a global scale. They won’t even be able to breathe freely anymore.”
The Pig King is drooling again. Even after taking control of Takt’s pigs, now he’s moving on to the pigs of the Three Hero Church? Busy people, indeed.
“And… the women captured by the heroes have been sent to me as well.”
“Ah… right. If I recall, the surviving sisters from the Three Hero Church faction were sent to the king, weren’t they?”
“Bufufufu, that’s right. Well, there weren’t that many of them, though.”
At this moment, Ren leans in and whispers to Father.
“Aren’t you taking too many concubines?”

Father raises his index finger to his lips in a “shh” gesture. Well, Father and the others don’t know the details. They probably just think of it as a punishment where unwanted brides are forced upon the king.
“The punishments in this world are hard to understand. I doubt this is an interesting story, so let’s just ignore it and move on.”
The Pig King patiently waits for Father and Ren to finish their whispered conversation. Surprisingly considerate for a pig. As expected of the king of pigs.
“Now then, Shield Hero. The Spear Hero mentioned the recording crystal… Would you care to see a video of me with my women—”
“N-No, I’m quite busy, so I’ll pass! I don’t have time to waste on romance, and I’m more than fulfilled already.”

Father subtly shifts his gaze toward Éclair. Oh? Could it be…? Éclair, on the other hand, furrows her brows in mild discomfort. The Pig King then turns his attention to Ren and Itsuki, but they both shake their heads furiously and glance at Éclair as if seeking help.
“Bufufufu, I see, I see. As expected of the heroes! It seems we’ll get along well! How about spending the night together?”
“I refuse!”
“H-He actually accepted that reasoning!?”
“What exactly did he figure out!?”
“Could it be…?”
Oh? It seems Father has realized something. His face pales as he looks at Éclair, Ren, and Itsuki.
“D-Did you realize something?”
“Most likely, His Majesty thinks that we’ve been taking turns with Lady Eclair—”
“Iwatani-dono.”
Éclair calls Father to order, making him stop mid-sentence. Ren and Itsuki seem to have caught on as well. Meanwhile, I simply hold hands with Yuki-chan and Kou, watching the scene unfold.
“Bufufufu, now then, I shall give the heroes their next task. That said, it is simply the job of suppressing the waves in each nation.”
“Yes, we plan to travel to each country as needed and establish a portal network.”
“The heroes are truly diligent workers. I hope that, if you have the capacity, you will take on additional tasks as well. Now then, I shall take my leave. Buhihihihi.”

And so, the Pig King finished his official duties and returned to frolicking with Takt’s pigs. Strangely enough, the ministers loyal to the Pig King seemed to find it preferable when he was off playing, as governmental work progressed smoothly and they even expressed their gratitude. But what was with that final war cry?
“Buhihihihī! That’s what he said—buhihi~!”
“Sakura-chan, don’t imitate him!”

Father scolds Sakura-chan. A Filolial crying out like that… Still, I would accept it! However, Father and the others seemed to disapprove, as even Ren and Itsuki joined in to caution her. Once that conversation wrapped up, Father spoke.
“That king seems competent when it counts, but honestly, isn’t he way too preoccupied with his lust…?”
Most of those present nodded in agreement and let out sighs.
“Exactly! I was treated like one of Iwatani-dono’s prostitutes!”
Éclair folded her arms in dissatisfaction. Exactly! There’s no way Father would lust after someone with such a silly-sounding name!
“I’m really sorry. That wasn’t my intention…”
“I apologize…”
“Yeah, there’s no way we’d lay hands on Eclair. Our bad.”
“…Why do I still feel unsatisfied hearing that?”
Éclair made a complicated expression. Perhaps I should take this opportunity to play with Yuki-chan and the others?
“Motoyasu-kun is completely out of the loop, huh?”
“Well… Just looking at Motoyasu-san, you can pretty much figure out what kind of person he is.”
“I never thought there’d be a day when I’d be jealous of Motoyasu.”

Oh? It feels like I’m being watched. Very well, I shall place my thumb and index finger under my chin in a confident pose. At the same time, I shall employ the technique I once practiced—making my teeth sparkle. Shing☆
“So cool, Motoyasu-sama!”
“Stop it, Motoyasu. You’re annoying.”
“Yes, quite annoying.”
“…When you do it in silence, it’s even worse.”
Oh? Father and the others seem slightly irritated. I have no intention of troubling Father and the rest, I say.
“It’s true! Naofumi is being targeted by Gaelion, so it’s totally out of the question for him to have any connection with Éclair!” At this moment, Rival asserts herself for some reason.
“Huh? What are you talking about?”
Sakura-chan tilts her head in confusion.
If I don’t act now, Father will be taken away!
“Sakura-chan! To protect Father’s purity, you must face off against Rival!”
“Ehh? Okay~!”
Shall I join in as well?
Hm? Rival is preparing to dazzle with her eyes. If I step in, she plans to use a flash attack.
Tch… What should I do?
“Motoyasu-kun, you’re trying to start another staring contest, but it’s dangerous, so stop, okay?”
“Understood. However, I will not let Rival have Father!”
“Ahh, sure, sure. Wyndia-chan, stop Gaelion for me.”
“Okaaay. Come on, Gaelion.”
“Uu… Big Sis, Gaelion won’t give up on Naofumi!”
Rival is weak against Assistant. The parent inside him is truly reserved.
“Seriously… I feel like all the tension just vanished instantly.”
“For now, let’s move on to the next job. Though I’m not Naofumi, we need to set up portals so we can travel instantly between countries.”
At this point, a minister-like figure raises his hand and steps in.
“Regarding that matter, please make use of the trains and flying machines we seized from Takt’s faction. They should get you to your destinations much faster than transport monsters.”
“Thank you. So there are trains as well?”
“Ga—”
Rival and the Filolials all freeze in shock.
“Gaelion’s job has been stolen!”
He then presses both hands against his cheeks in dramatic protest.
“Motoyasu-sama! Are we being discarded?!”
Oh? Even in the previous loop, we used the vehicles seized from Takt. So why this reaction now? Sakura-chan doesn’t seem to get it.
“Why would you think that!? Gaelion-chan and the others get tired too, right? So if we can use something, we should!”
“It’s a matter of Gaelion’s pride!”
“Pride…?”
“Even in Faubrey, they have trains, and now they’re treating it like some kind of identity crisis?” Itsuki asks Yuki-chan.
What kind of obvious question is that?
“Of course! Trains are our enemies!”
“Filolials are really…”
“Hmm? Really?”
“Judging from Sakura’s reaction, this might just be a personal issue.”
“Hmm?”
“Kou-san seems the same. It’s only Gaelion and Yuki-san.”
A complicated issue. But last time, Rival didn’t make such a fuss. No, perhaps Father convinced them beforehand?
“Gaelion, don’t be so selfish.”
“No! No! But it’s Gaelion who carries Naofumi!”
Rival desperately tries to persuade Assistant. He is failing completely.
“Well, Naofumi is the one riding Gaelion anyway… so…”
He’s muttering in a lovestruck manner! Shall I kill him? Just as I was about to channel power into my spear, Father and the others ignored Rival and started walking.
“Alright, let’s move out and prepare for the wave.”
It seems everyone shares the same understanding—leaving Rival, Sakura-chan, and me completely out of the loop.
“Muu! I won’t let you!”
“Don’t ignore meee!”
“I won’t allow it!”
I chased after Father and the others.
